intent: Reserve volunteer places durably without overbooking, duplicate requests or resurrected cancellations.

criteria.description: Seed welcome with 2 places and garden with 3; accept only positive safe integer seats; reject overbooking without durable change.
The same requestId and parameters returns the same reservation, including after reopen; conflicts reject without change.
Cancellation restores capacity once; replay remains cancelled, including after reopen.
Active and cancelled reservation states survive repeated store reopening in one process.
